_note: v2.9 plan 05 (no-model lane): a two-step pattern over visible transitions publishes its pending line (snapshot.patterns), completes on the second transition into an authored What changed line on the player Overview, shows in the Author panel only in Author view, and a delete of the completing turn takes the callback back (rollback). assert-player-clean in player mode with the callback shown. No model call: extraction is pinned to SCENE_NONE. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v29-05-patterns.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; globalThis.__p05 = { pause, until, LINE: 'Through the gate and on into the yard, without a halt.', PENDING: 'One more door stands between the party and rest.' }; return { at: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId, projection: Array.isArray(rt.getSnapshot().patterns) };
